name: income_statement

description: PLACEHOLDER section until the end-user (Kristian, SEB) tells us which note he needs on 2026-09-15. Demonstrates the schema format; swap or add files here, no code changes needed.
value_convention: Numbers exactly as printed in the report (costs usually negative). Unit = the unit stated in the table header (MSEK, SEK m, MEUR, USD m ...). Period = fiscal year the column refers to, as 'YYYY'.

fields.label: Revenue
fields.description: Total revenues / net sales for the group, current fiscal year.

fields.label: Cost of sales
fields.description: Cost of sales / cost of goods sold, as printed (typically negative).

fields.label: Profit before tax
fields.description: Profit before income tax / resultat före skatt.

fields.label: Income tax
fields.description: Income tax expense, as printed (typically negative).

fields.label: Profit for the year
fields.description: Profit for the year / årets resultat, total (before split to owners / NCI).

fields.label: EPS, basic
fields.description: Basic earnings per share attributable to owners of the parent.
